title: Insects and Spiders
body: As well as Wasps, we can provide treatments for Ants, Cockroaches, Fleas, Flies, Bed Bugs, Silverfish, Woodlice, Stored Product Insects (SPIs), different species of Spiders and many more. Costing for these treatments is only a phone call away.
We only use the industry's latest trusted Traps, Solutions, Gels and Powders.
